# PageFlip

> PageFlip is a modern page-turning library for building flip books, catalogs, magazines, comics, and document viewers with a polished reading experience. It ships as an ecosystem of TypeScript-first packages: a renderer-agnostic core, React wrapper, Web Components, and an optional theme layer.

## Packages

- [@pageflip/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pageflip/react): React 18+ wrapper with SSR-safe integration.
- [@pageflip/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pageflip/core): Low-level engine, renderer agnostic, Canvas 2D, zero dependencies.
- [@pageflip/web-component](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pageflip/web-component): Framework-agnostic custom elements.
- [@pageflip/theme](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pageflip/theme): UI components, tokens, and styling primitives.
- [@pageflip/renderers](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pageflip/renderers): Renderer integrations.

## Resources

- [Documentation](https://pageflip.dev): Guides, API reference, and examples.
- [Repository](https://github.com/ignaciobockl/pageflip): Source code and issues.
- [Playground](http://localhost:5173): Interactive demos of the library components.
